instruction:
Use UV Master to unwrap the opened `scene.obj`, a single head mesh named Head with 2,114 vertices and 2,178 faces, then export `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` with UVs. On this machine, open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `scene.obj`. Preserve the base geometry and object/group name.

Every face must reference UV coordinates, all UVs must lie in [0,1]^2, and the layout must have no positive-area overlap between UV triangles; shared island edges and vertices are allowed. The summed UV face area must be between 0.5 and 1.05. The worst per-face UV-area/world-area ratio, normalized by the median ratio in both expansion and compression directions, must remain below 15.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
